name: GLYCERIN
notes: Highly effective moisture-binding ingredient; well-tolerated by all skin types including sensitive.

name: SODIUM HYALURONATE
notes: Holds up to 1000x its weight in water; key hydration ingredient. Low-MW versions penetrate deeper.

name: NIACINAMIDE
notes: Regulates sebum, reduces hyperpigmentation, strengthens barrier. May cause flushing at high concentrations (>10%).

name: PANTHENOL
notes: Converts to pantothenic acid in skin; soothes, heals, and moisturizes. Excellent tolerance profile.

name: UREA
notes: Keratolytic at higher concentrations (>10%); humectant at low levels. Can sting on broken skin.

name: SQUALANE
notes: Stable, lightweight emollient structurally similar to skin's own sebum. Excellent for all skin types.

name: SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS SEED OIL
notes: Technically a liquid wax; closely mimics sebum. Generally well-tolerated, low comedogenicity.

name: BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII BUTTER
notes: Rich emollient with anti-inflammatory properties. Non-comedogenic despite thick texture.

name: CETYL ALCOHOL
notes: Fatty alcohol used as emollient and texture agent; not irritating like ethyl alcohol. May clog pores slightly.

name: STEARIC ACID
notes: Saturated fatty acid; common in skin; used as emollient and emulsifier. Slightly comedogenic.

name: DIMETHICONE
notes: Forms a protective barrier; seals in moisture; gives slip. Non-irritating but may trap impurities.

name: CYCLOMETHICONE
notes: Volatile silicone carrier; evaporates on skin. D4/D5 cyclics are under EU regulatory scrutiny.

name: CYCLOPENTASILOXANE
notes: Volatile silicone; smooth skin feel. EU restricted due to environmental persistence.

name: METHYLPARABEN
notes: Widely used preservative; low toxicity in current literature despite controversy. Potential sensitizer at high concentrations.

name: PROPYLPARABEN
notes: Paraben preservative; more lipophilic than methylparaben. Restricted in EU for leave-on products near diaper area.

name: PHENOXYETHANOL
notes: Common paraben alternative; broad-spectrum antimicrobial. Can irritate sensitive skin at concentrations >1%.

name: BENZALKONIUM CHLORIDE
notes: Potent antimicrobial; common sensitizer and skin barrier disruptor. Avoid in leave-on products for sensitive skin.

name: SODIUM BENZOATE
notes: Effective preservative at low pH. Generally safe; potential mild irritant in some individuals.

name: PARFUM
notes: Catch-all term for fragrance mixtures; major cause of cosmetic contact dermatitis. Avoid for sensitive/reactive skin.

name: LIMONENE
notes: Citrus-derived fragrance terpene; common sensitizer. Oxidized form more allergenic. EU requires labeling.

name: LINALOOL
notes: Floral fragrance found in lavender; known sensitizer especially when oxidized. EU requires labeling.

name: CITRONELLOL
notes: Rose/geranium fragrance component; moderate sensitizer. EU requires labeling at >0.001% in leave-on.

name: GERANIOL
notes: Fragrance component in rose and palmarosa; sensitizer. EU requires labeling. Avoid in products for reactive skin.

name: ETHYLHEXYL METHOXYCINNAMATE
notes: Chemical UVB filter; most common in sunscreens. Potential endocrine disruptor concerns; absorbs into bloodstream.

name: BUTYL METHOXYDIBENZOYLMETHANE
notes: Broad-spectrum UVA filter; photounstable alone—requires stabilizers like octocrylene. Low irritation potential.

name: ZINC OXIDE
notes: Mineral broad-spectrum UV filter (UVA+UVB); non-irritating, suitable for sensitive and acne-prone skin.

name: TITANIUM DIOXIDE
notes: Mineral UVB/short UVA filter; non-irritating. May leave white cast on deeper skin tones.

name: BENZOPHENONE-3
notes: Chemical UVA/UVB filter; significant endocrine disruption evidence; banned in some reef-protection jurisdictions. Avoid.

name: RETINOL
notes: Gold-standard anti-aging active; increases cell turnover, stimulates collagen. Causes initial purging and photosensitivity.

name: RETINAL
notes: One conversion step from retinoic acid; faster acting than retinol with less irritation than tretinoin.

name: TRETINOIN
notes: Prescription-strength retinoid; direct form of vitamin A. Highly effective but causes dryness, peeling, photosensitivity.

name: ASCORBIC ACID
notes: Antioxidant; brightens, stimulates collagen synthesis. Unstable in formulation; low pH required for penetration.

name: ALPHA-ARBUTIN
notes: Tyrosinase inhibitor for hyperpigmentation; more stable and less irritating than hydroquinone. Suitable for sensitive skin.

name: KOJIC ACID
notes: Tyrosinase inhibitor for brightening; can cause contact dermatitis at >2% concentrations.

name: AZELAIC ACID
notes: Anti-acne, anti-rosacea, brightening; reduces P. acnes and melanin synthesis. Excellent for sensitive/reactive skin.

name: BENZOYL PEROXIDE
notes: Bactericidal against P. acnes; effective for inflammatory acne. Causes dryness, bleaches fabric; start at 2.5%.

name: SALICYLIC ACID
notes: Oil-soluble BHA; exfoliates inside pores, anti-inflammatory, comedolytic. Ideal for acne-prone and oily skin.

name: GLYCOLIC ACID
notes: Smallest AHA; penetrates deeply; exfoliates, brightens, stimulates collagen. Increases photosensitivity. Use SPF.

name: LACTIC ACID
notes: Milder AHA than glycolic; exfoliates and hydrates (humectant properties). Better tolerated by sensitive skin.

name: MANDELIC ACID
notes: Gentle AHA; antibacterial properties. Larger molecule = slower penetration = less irritation. Good for sensitive/rosacea.

name: CARBOMER
notes: Synthetic polymer gelling agent; creates clear gels. Generally well-tolerated. Neutralization required for stability.

name: XANTHAN GUM
notes: Natural polysaccharide thickener; fermented from corn sugar. Excellent safety profile; used in food and cosmetics.

name: CETEARYL ALCOHOL
notes: Fatty alcohol blend used as emulsifier, thickener, emollient. Mild potential for comedogenicity.

name: PEG-100 STEARATE
notes: PEG-based emulsifier; effective and mild. May contain trace ethylene oxide; concern for compromised skin.

name: COCOS NUCIFERA OIL
notes: High in lauric acid; antimicrobial but highly comedogenic. Avoid for acne-prone skin. Comedogenic rating: 4/5.

name: OLEA EUROPAEA FRUIT OIL
notes: Rich in oleic acid; may disrupt skin barrier with prolonged use. Moderate comedogenic rating.

name: ARGANIA SPINOSA KERNEL OIL
notes: Rich in linoleic acid and vitamin E; non-comedogenic. Good for acne-prone and dry skin.

name: ROSA CANINA FRUIT OIL
notes: High in linoleic acid and retinoids; beneficial for scarring and aging. Low comedogenic rating.

name: SCLEROCARYA BIRREA SEED OIL
notes: Lightweight, fast-absorbing; high in oleic and linoleic acids. Low comedogenic, antioxidant-rich.

name: MELALEUCA ALTERNIFOLIA LEAF OIL
notes: Antimicrobial essential oil; common skin sensitizer. Oxidizes quickly. Use diluted (<5%); avoid on sensitive skin.

name: LAVANDULA ANGUSTIFOLIA OIL
notes: Popular essential oil; contains linalool and linalyl acetate—both sensitizers. Avoid for sensitive/reactive skin.

name: ALCOHOL DENAT.
notes: Denatured ethanol; disrupts skin barrier, strips natural oils, promotes transepidermal water loss. Avoid in dry/sensitive skin.

name: SODIUM LAURYL SULFATE
notes: Harsh anionic surfactant; significant barrier disruptor and irritant. Avoid for sensitive, dry, eczema-prone skin.

name: SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE
notes: Milder than SLS; ethoxylated. May contain trace 1,4-dioxane. Common lathering agent; less irritating but still sensitizing.

name: THEOBROMA CACAO SEED BUTTER
notes: Rich, occlusive butter; highly comedogenic. Avoid for acne-prone skin. Good for dry/dehydrated skin elsewhere.

name: ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE
notes: Highly comedogenic penetration enhancer. Frequently cited as causing acne mechanica. Avoid for acne-prone skin.

name: ISOPROPYL PALMITATE
notes: Comedogenic emollient; lighter feel than IPM but still high clogging potential. Avoid for acne-prone skin.

name: WATER
notes: Primary solvent in most cosmetic formulations. Completely inert and safe.

name: TOCOPHEROL
notes: Antioxidant; stabilizes formulas, protects cell membranes. Mild comedogenic potential from some derivatives.

name: TOCOPHERYL ACETATE
notes: Stable vitamin E ester; needs skin conversion to active form. Lower potency than free tocopherol.

name: ALLANTOIN
notes: Keratolytic and soothing agent; promotes cell regeneration. Excellent tolerance profile; good for sensitive/irritated skin.

name: CENTELLA ASIATICA EXTRACT
notes: Anti-inflammatory; contains madecassoside, asiaticoside. Promotes wound healing, soothes irritation, strengthens barrier.

name: CERAMIDE NP
notes: Key barrier lipid; restores and maintains skin barrier integrity. Essential for dry/eczema-prone skin.

name: CERAMIDE AP
notes: Ceramide variant that aids barrier repair; often combined with ceramide NP and EOP in formulations.

name: CERAMIDE EOP
notes: Long-chain ceramide critical for lamellar body structure and skin barrier function.

name: CHOLESTEROL
notes: Natural skin lipid; with ceramides and fatty acids forms the skin barrier trilayer. Excellent safety profile.

name: POLYGLUTAMIC ACID
notes: Fermentation-derived humectant; holds more water than hyaluronic acid. Film-forming properties.

name: BETAINE
notes: Amino acid derivative; hydrating, soothing osmoprotectant. Excellent tolerability.

name: NEOPENTYL GLYCOL DIHEPTANOATE
notes: Lightweight emollient ester; dry skin feel, minimal comedogenicity.

name: PROPYLENE GLYCOL
notes: Effective humectant and solvent; can cause contact dermatitis in sensitive individuals at higher concentrations.

name: BUTYLENE GLYCOL
notes: Milder than propylene glycol; good solvent and humectant. Excellent safety profile.

name: PENTYLENE GLYCOL
notes: Multifunctional; humectant, solvent, and mild preservative booster. Good tolerability.

name: SODIUM PCA
notes: Natural moisturizing factor (NMF) component; excellent skin-identical humectant.

name: INOSITOL
notes: B-vitamin family; barrier-supporting, soothing. Often used in sensitive skin formulations.

name: ASCORBYL GLUCOSIDE
notes: Stable vitamin C derivative; enzymatically cleaved to ascorbic acid in skin. Gentler than pure L-AA.

name: SODIUM ASCORBYL PHOSPHATE
notes: Stable, water-soluble vitamin C derivative; antimicrobial properties; well-tolerated antioxidant.

name: MAGNESIUM ASCORBYL PHOSPHATE
notes: Stable vitamin C derivative; brightening and antioxidant. Good for sensitive skin.

name: RESVERATROL
notes: Polyphenol antioxidant; anti-aging, anti-inflammatory. Often paired with ferulic acid.

name: FERULIC ACID
notes: Plant antioxidant; stabilizes vitamin C formulas, extends photo-protection. Used at 0.5% with C+E.

name: COENZYME Q10
notes: Cellular energy carrier and antioxidant; anti-aging. Reduces fine lines in studies. Excellent safety.

name: BAKUCHIOL
notes: Plant-derived retinol alternative; reduces wrinkles with less irritation. Suitable for sensitive skin.

name: TRANEXAMIC ACID
notes: Tyrosinase inhibitor; treats hyperpigmentation and melasma. Good tolerability, safe for sensitive skin.

name: PHYTIC ACID
notes: Natural chelating agent; mild AHA alternative, antioxidant. Brightening properties.

name: RETINYL PALMITATE
notes: Esterified retinol; weak retinoid activity, more stable. Requires multiple conversions to become active.

name: RETINYL PROPIONATE
notes: Retinol ester; better tolerated than retinol, with efficacy between retinyl palmitate and retinol.

name: SULFUR
notes: Keratolytic and antimicrobial; effective for acne, seborrheic dermatitis, rosacea. Can cause dryness and odor.

name: ZINC PCA
notes: Sebum-regulating active; antibacterial. Good for oily and acne-prone skin.

name: COPPER PEPTIDE
notes: Collagen and elastin stimulator; wound healing, anti-aging. Caution when combined with strong antioxidants or retinoids.

name: ARGIRELINE
notes: Peptide that inhibits neuromuscular transmission mildly; marketed as botox-like for expression lines.

name: MATRIXYL
notes: Collagen-stimulating peptide; reduces wrinkle depth. Strong evidence base. Well-tolerated.

name: PALMITOYL TRIPEPTIDE-1
notes: Collagen-stimulating signal peptide; anti-aging. Often combined with palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7.

name: EPIDERMAL GROWTH FACTOR
notes: Protein that stimulates cell proliferation; anti-aging, wound healing. Controversial for healthy skin use.

name: ADENOSINE
notes: Purine nucleoside; anti-aging, smoothing fine lines. Excellent safety profile, used in Korean formulations.

name: SODIUM HYALURONATE CROSSPOLYMER
notes: Crosslinked HA that stays on skin surface longer; extended hydration vs. standard HA.

name: HYDROXYETHYLCELLULOSE
notes: Plant-derived cellulose thickener; forms clear gels. Excellent safety profile.

name: HYDROXYPROPYL METHYLCELLULOSE
notes: Cellulose-derived thickener/film former. Very low irritation potential.

name: CARRAGEENAN
notes: Seaweed-derived thickener; some debate about degraded forms. Topical use considered safe.

name: SODIUM CARBOXYMETHYL CELLULOSE
notes: Cellulose derivative thickener; widely used, excellent safety.

name: POLYQUATERNIUM-10
notes: Cationic polymer conditioner; used in hair and skin products for slip and moisture retention.

name: CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE
notes: Cationic surfactant/preservative; antimicrobial and conditioning. Can irritate skin at concentrations >0.1%.

name: DISODIUM EDTA
notes: Chelating agent that enhances preservative efficacy; penetration-enhancing properties at higher levels.

name: TETRASODIUM EDTA
notes: Stronger chelator than disodium EDTA; used to stabilize formulas and boost preservatives.

name: BHT
notes: Synthetic antioxidant/preservative; moderate endocrine concern; potential sensitizer at higher concentrations.

name: ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN
notes: Preservative enhancer and skin conditioning agent; often paired with phenoxyethanol. Good tolerability.

name: CAPRYLYL GLYCOL
notes: Multifunctional preservative and humectant; antimicrobial activity, moisturizing. Well-tolerated.

name: CHLORPHENESIN
notes: Preservative active against gram-positive bacteria and fungi; moderate sensitizer potential.

name: DEHYDROACETIC ACID
notes: Broad-spectrum preservative; often used with benzyl alcohol. Generally considered safe.

name: BENZYL ALCOHOL
notes: Used as preservative, solvent, and fragrance. Can cause contact urticaria; EU fragrance allergen.

name: POTASSIUM SORBATE
notes: Fungistatic preservative; generally considered safe and mild. Less effective alone, synergistic with other preservatives.

name: CITRIC ACID
notes: pH adjuster and mild AHA; buffering agent. At low concentrations, well-tolerated; higher concentrations can irritate.

name: SODIUM HYDROXIDE
notes: Strong base used to adjust product pH to skin-compatible levels. Neutralized in formula; used in trace amounts.

name: TRIETHANOLAMINE
notes: pH adjuster and emulsifier; potential sensitizer with prolonged use; potential for nitrosamine formation.

name: POLYSORBATE 20
notes: Non-ionic surfactant/emulsifier; very mild. Potential for trace ethylene oxide contamination.

name: POLYSORBATE 80
notes: Non-ionic surfactant/emulsifier; mildly comedogenic. Common solubilizer for fragrance.

name: GLYCERYL STEARATE
notes: Non-ionic emulsifier/emollient; naturally occurring glycerol ester. Good tolerability.

name: STEARYL ALCOHOL
notes: Fatty alcohol; emollient, emulsifier, thickener. Low irritation, mild comedogenic potential.

name: ISOSTEARIC ACID
notes: Branched-chain fatty acid emollient; moderately comedogenic.

name: CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE
notes: Fractionated coconut oil; lightweight, skin-identical lipid. Excellent safety; minimal comedogenicity.

name: COCO-CAPRYLATE
notes: Lightweight emollient ester; silicone-like skin feel without cyclosiloxane concerns.

name: CAMELLIA SINENSIS LEAF EXTRACT
notes: Potent antioxidant; anti-inflammatory, photoprotective. Stabilizes vitamin C, soothes UV damage.

name: VITIS VINIFERA SEED EXTRACT
notes: Strong polyphenol antioxidant; anti-inflammatory, anti-aging. Excellent safety.

name: CURCUMIN
notes: Anti-inflammatory; brightening; poor skin penetration without delivery systems.

name: NEEM OIL
notes: Antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory; strong odor. Can irritate sensitive skin. Potent acne-fighting properties.

name: EVENING PRIMROSE OIL
notes: High in GLA (gamma-linolenic acid); anti-inflammatory, good for eczema. Moderate comedogenicity.

name: SEA BUCKTHORN OIL
notes: Bright orange oil; extremely high in carotenoids and vitamin C. Potent but can stain skin/formulas orange.

name: HEMP SEED OIL
notes: Excellent linoleic/linolenic acid balance; non-comedogenic, anti-inflammatory. Good for acne-prone skin.

name: SUNFLOWER SEED OIL
notes: High linoleic acid; non-comedogenic, barrier-supporting. Good emollient for sensitive/dry skin.

name: SAFFLOWER SEED OIL
notes: Very high linoleic acid (>75%); non-comedogenic. Often used in acne-prone skin formulations.

name: SWEET ALMOND OIL
notes: Mild emollient; balanced oleic/linoleic acids. Moderate comedogenicity; avoid for acne-prone skin.

name: AVOCADO OIL
notes: Rich in oleic acid and vitamins A, D, E; moderately comedogenic. Better for dry/mature skin.

name: GRAPESEED OIL
notes: Lightweight, high in linoleic acid; low comedogenicity; suitable for oily skin.

name: CASTOR OIL
notes: Thick, occlusive; used in lip products and hair. Ricinoleic acid has anti-inflammatory properties.

name: CAMELLIA OIL
notes: High oleic acid; similar to sebum; skin-compatible. Light texture; traditional Japanese skincare ingredient.

name: SEA KELP EXTRACT
notes: Rich in minerals, vitamins; antioxidant, soothing. Hydrating and firming properties.

name: SODIUM CHLORIDE
notes: Thickening agent in shampoos; can be drying and irritating at high concentrations.

name: SILICA
notes: Oil-absorbing powder; mattifying effect; used in sunscreens and primers.

name: MICA
notes: Natural mineral; provides shimmer and luminosity in cosmetics. Inert and safe.

name: IRON OXIDE
notes: Natural mineral pigment; used for color in foundations, tinted products. Excellent safety profile.

name: KAOLIN
notes: Naturally occurring clay; absorbs sebum, mattifies. Used in masks and dry formulas.

name: BENTONITE
notes: Swelling clay used in masks; deep cleansing, pore-clearing. Overuse can dry skin.

name: POLYETHYLENE
notes: Synthetic wax; formerly used as microbeads (now banned in many countries for environmental reasons).

name: STEARETH-2
notes: PEG-based emulsifier; moderately comedogenic. Used in creams and lotions.

name: STEARETH-20
notes: PEG-based emulsifier; milder comedogenic profile than steareth-2.

name: COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE
notes: Mild amphoteric surfactant; used in shampoos and cleansers. Can cause contact sensitization.

name: COCAMIDE MEA
notes: Fatty acid monoethanolamide; thickener and foam booster. Mild but moderately comedogenic.

name: LAURYL GLUCOSIDE
notes: Mild non-ionic surfactant; plant-derived; gentle on skin and eyes.

name: DECYL GLUCOSIDE
notes: Very mild surfactant; biodegradable, derived from sugar and fatty alcohols. Good for sensitive skin.

name: METHYL GLUCOSE SESQUISTEARATE
notes: Non-ionic emulsifier derived from glucose; good moisturizing properties.

name: BEHENYL ALCOHOL
notes: Long-chain fatty alcohol; thickener and emollient. Antiviral properties against herpes (OTC).

name: MYRISTYL ALCOHOL
notes: Fatty alcohol; moderately comedogenic. Used as thickener and emollient.

name: LAURIC ACID
notes: Saturated fatty acid from coconut oil; antibacterial but highly comedogenic. Drives coconut oil's pore-clogging.

name: MYRISTIC ACID
notes: Saturated fatty acid; moderately comedogenic. Used as emollient and cleansing agent.

name: PALMITIC ACID
notes: Major skin-identical fatty acid; moisturizing. Mild comedogenicity.

name: OLEIC ACID
notes: Monounsaturated fatty acid; promotes penetration but can disrupt barrier in excess. Moderate comedogenicity.

name: LINOLEIC ACID
notes: Essential fatty acid; deficiency linked to acne. Anti-inflammatory, barrier-supporting, non-comedogenic.

name: POLYGLYCERYL-3 BEESWAX
notes: Modified beeswax derivative; water-in-oil emulsifier with good skin tolerance.

name: CERA ALBA
notes: Natural wax from honeybees; occlusive, emollient, emulsifying. Low comedogenicity despite thick texture.

name: CARNAUBA WAX
notes: Hard plant wax; used in lip products, mascaras, and sunscreens. Excellent safety.

name: MINERAL OIL
notes: Highly refined petroleum derivative; occlusive, non-comedogenic when highly refined. Long historical safety data.

name: PETROLATUM
notes: Most effective occlusive ingredient; seals in moisture, prevents TEWL. Non-comedogenic; excellent for dry/eczema skin.

name: LANOLIN
notes: Highly effective emollient from sheep wool; potential allergen in lanolin-sensitive individuals.

name: TRIETHYL CITRATE
notes: Plasticizer used in nail polish and hair products; deodorant properties.

name: ISODECYL NEOPENTANOATE
notes: Lightweight ester emollient; non-greasy; used in skin and hair products.

name: HELIANTHUS ANNUUS SEED WAX
notes: Plant-derived wax; structuring agent in anhydrous formulas. Very mild.

name: LECITHIN
notes: Skin-identical phospholipid; barrier-repairing, penetration-enhancing. Excellent tolerance.

name: SODIUM LAUROYL SARCOSINATE
notes: Mild anionic surfactant; gentle cleansing with good skin compatibility.

name: AMINOMETHYL PROPANOL
notes: pH adjuster; can form nitrosamines in certain formulations. Moderate irritation potential.

name: DIPROPYLENE GLYCOL
notes: Solvent; mild humectant properties. Used in fragrance dilution. Low irritation.

name: HEXYLENE GLYCOL
notes: Solvent and humectant; moderate irritant at higher concentrations. Less favorable safety profile than BG or PG.

name: DIAZOLIDINYL UREA
notes: Formaldehyde-releasing preservative; broad spectrum. Formaldehyde releasers are common sensitizers—avoid for reactive skin.

name: IMIDAZOLIDINYL UREA
notes: Formaldehyde-releasing preservative; common sensitizer. Seek alternatives for sensitive skin products.

name: DMDM HYDANTOIN
notes: Formaldehyde-releasing preservative; significant sensitization risk. Should be avoided where possible.

name: QUATERNIUM-15
notes: High-releasing formaldehyde donor; most common cause of formaldehyde-related contact dermatitis. Avoid.

name: BRONOPOL
notes: Broad-spectrum preservative; formaldehyde releaser; can form nitrosamines. Avoid for sensitive formulations.

name: IODOPROPYNYL BUTYLCARBAMATE
notes: Potent antifungal preservative; potential sensitizer; restricted in EU for rinse-off products.

name: POLYACRYLAMIDE
notes: Film-forming polymer; acrylamide monomer impurities are carcinogenic. Safety depends on purity/grade.

name: ACRYLATES/C10-30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER
notes: Gelling polymer; forms transparent gels. Better tolerability than regular carbomer.

name: AMINOPROPYL ASCORBYL PHOSPHATE
notes: Vitamin C derivative; cell-permeable, stable. Good antioxidant and brightening properties.

name: ETHYL ASCORBIC ACID
notes: Stable, skin-permeable vitamin C derivative; direct brightening and antioxidant activity.

name: PALMITOYL TETRAPEPTIDE-7
notes: Signal peptide; reduces excess cytokine production (anti-inflammatory); anti-aging. Part of matrixyl 3000 complex.

name: ACETYL OCTAPEPTIDE-3
notes: Expression peptide; inhibits acetylcholine release mildly. Wrinkle-reducing properties.

name: TRIPEPTIDE-1
notes: Collagen-stimulating tripeptide; naturally occurring in plasma. Anti-aging, wound healing.

name: SODIUM METABISULFITE
notes: Reducing agent/antioxidant preservative; potential sensitizer; sulfite sensitivity in some individuals.

name: BUTYLATED HYDROXYANISOLE
notes: Synthetic antioxidant; endocrine disruption concerns; potential carcinogen at high doses. EU restricted.

name: ETHANOL
notes: Evaporative solvent; antimicrobial at >60%; skin barrier disruptor. Less damaging than alcohol denat.

name: ISOPROPYL ALCOHOL
notes: Stronger barrier disruptor than ethanol; drying, denaturing. Avoid in leave-on formulations for sensitive skin.

name: ACETONE
notes: Strong solvent; significant defatting and irritation. Used in nail polish removers. Not for skin products.

name: DIMETHYL ISOSORBIDE
notes: Penetration-enhancing solvent; improves active ingredient delivery. Can increase other ingredients' irritation potential.

name: SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE
notes: Mild anionic surfactant from coconut; gentler than SLS. Good for sensitive/dry skin cleansers.

name: BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE
notes: Cationic surfactant; hair and skin conditioner. Milder than cetyltrimethylammonium chloride.

name: POLYSILICONE-11
notes: Crosslinked silicone; silky skin feel without heavy residue. Non-volatile; lower environmental concern.

name: POLYMETHYLSILSESQUIOXANE
notes: Silicone resin powder; mattifying effect, silky texture. Used in primers and foundations.

name: AMODIMETHICONE
notes: Amino-functionalized silicone; substantive to negatively charged hair/skin. Used in hair repair products.

name: OCTOCRYLENE
notes: Stabilizes avobenzone; UVB/UVA filter. Accumulates in coral reefs; potential endocrine effects.

name: HOMOSALATE
notes: UVB filter; potential endocrine disruptor. EU limited to 7.34%; higher concentration proposed safe.

name: ETHYLHEXYL SALICYLATE
notes: UVB filter; generally mild. Enhances penetration of other UVB filters.

name: MEXORYL SX
notes: Short UVA filter; highly photostable. Does not penetrate skin. Considered safe; used in L'Oreal patents.

name: TINOSORB S
notes: Broad-spectrum UVA/UVB filter; photostable; does not penetrate skin. Excellent safety profile.

name: TINOSORB M
notes: Broad-spectrum, photostable UV filter; physical/chemical hybrid. Does not absorb through skin. Excellent safety.
